message:
test(sh-strength r4): a size that never comes, a pan with no new frame, the touch fence, and B through the real Activity

- seam faults (test builds only, through shTestFault): layout:<n>[@<k>] (the size check lies), holdplace:<ms>
  (the GL side takes a placement late).
- fixture CASES_AB: layoutB133_never (no video drawn, bounded cleared swaps, then failed) and panB133_redraw (one
  redraw at the moved place, timestamp kept, after 3 lying checks). The summary is read from the app's file
  (logcat cuts the line past ~4 KB).
- AVD scenario layout_b: letterbox/corner taps, the viewer's rotate button (portrait and back), 크게보기 + 화면 이동
  pan, a display resize (wm size, restored), the fence (holdplace 8 s: the tap in the gap not sent, the next one
  right), fallback (swap:40 -> direct, still placed, tap right). Scroll shimmer: no oracle here, not judged.
- mutants: r3 fall-through -> layoutB133_never FAIL; r3 redraw wait -> panB133_redraw FAIL x2; no fence ->
  the fence check FAIL.
